title: Daily Devotional #6
paragraphs: As I read through Matthew chapter 6, I am reminded of the importance of seeking You above all else. In this chapter, You teach us about prayer, giving to others, and storing up treasures in heaven.

Firstly, You teach us about prayer. You remind us that we should pray in secret, not to be seen by others, but to communicate with You intimately. You also remind us not to use empty phrases or repetition, but to pray with sincerity and purpose. Help me to remember these things as I come before You in prayer, seeking Your will for my life and the needs of those around me.

You also teach us about giving to others. You remind us that we should give generously and cheerfully, not for the praise of others, but to bless those in need. You promise that when we give, we will be rewarded in heaven. Help me to have a generous heart and to seek out opportunities to give to others, even when it may not be convenient or easy.

Lastly, You teach us about storing up treasures in heaven. You remind us that our earthly possessions are temporary and can be easily destroyed, but the treasures we store up in heaven are eternal. Help me to remember this truth and to focus my heart and mind on eternal things, rather than temporary pleasures.

Lord, as I reflect on these teachings, I pray that You would help me to live them out in my daily life. May I seek You above all else, give generously to others, and store up treasures in heaven. Thank You for Your love and grace, and for the guidance You give us through Your Word.
